question: Does standing aside when funding shows the trend side is crowded (trailing 3-day per-8h funding beyond +/-0.03%) improve the trend core, net of funding costs?
registration_note: Declared 2026-09-27 before any result of this overlay was computed. Distinct from discovery-v2 sprint-1 funding_extreme_reversal, a standalone reversal strategy; this is a risk overlay on the frozen trend core. Descriptive on seen crypto history.

overlay.normalization: sum of settlements in window / 9 (per-8h equivalent)
overlay.action: crowded side -> flat; resumes when funding normalizes

base_book: crypto-trend-core design (DON8 + EMA8, 17 perps, entry inverse-vol sleeves), v3.1 with funding, 20 bps
funding_data: Binance USDT-M funding history as a cross-venue proxy (MEXC history starts 2025-04); both books are charged it
reported: Sharpe, t, max drawdown, annual return
